description: Resolves the family, downloads the actual woff2 files into the project, and appends @font-face rules to a CSS file. Self-hosted — no CDN request at runtime. Returns the exact font-family name to use.

cssPath.description: CSS file to create or append to, e.g. ./src/fonts.css. Must be inside the workspace root. Prefer a stylesheet the project already imports; a new file has to be imported by hand.

family.description: Family name, as list_fonts reports it

targetDir.description: Where the font files go, e.g. ./public/fonts. Relative paths resolve against the client's workspace root, and must stay inside it.

urlPrefix.description: The public URL path the files will be served from — not a disk path. Files land in targetDir; the CSS points at urlPrefix. If your static root is public/, then targetDir './public/fonts' pairs with urlPrefix '/fonts'. Defaults to '/fonts'.

weights.description: e.g. ['400','700']. For variable fonts use ['100 900']. Defaults to ['400','700'].

name: install_font
title: Download a font into the project
